policies.text: Primary vendor status is assigned to any supplier holding tier-one contractor status.

A business partner demonstrates robust commercial success either by achieving a client satisfaction mark of 85% or higher together with a minimum count of 2 regional service hubs, or by completing 10 or more enterprise deployments last quarter.
Inclusion on the cleared supplier roster is authorized for any contractor achieving entry-level vendor eligibility.
Information security clearance is granted to a software provider holding ISO 27001 certification.
Finalization of a long-term supply agreement is cleared for a supplier holding primary vendor status that offers an evaluation period of at least 14 days.
Tier-one contractor status is granted to a vendor satisfying technical operational standards that is also approved for priority contract discussions.
A vendor fulfills regional presence benchmarks if they maintain a minimum count of 2 regional service hubs.
Permission for priority contract discussions requires a vendor demonstrating robust commercial success along with liability coverage of at least $3,000,000.
Technical operational standards are satisfied by holding SOC 2 Type II compliance, maintaining an issue response time under 4 hours, or demonstrating network availability of at least 99.5%.
An enterprise vendor gains sustainable supplier certification if they offset at least 500 metric tons of carbon emissions annually.
Entry-level vendor eligibility is awarded either to a supplier maintaining a minimum count of 2 regional service hubs or to one holding SOC 2 Type II compliance.
A hardware provider is selected for equipment leasing when maintaining an emergency spare inventory of at least 100 units.
Transport volume clearance is granted to a logistics provider operating 30 or more delivery trucks.
